definitions.gloss: wasabi pickles; wasabi preserved in sake lees
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese pickle made by chopping wasabi stems, leaves, and roots and preserving them in sake lees (kasuzuke). A specialty of Shizuoka Prefecture, where most Japanese wasabi is grown.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{山葵|わさび}→山葵：05121_wasabi⟧ (wasabi) and {漬|づ}け (pickled; preserved). The suffix ~{漬|づ}け indicates preservation, as in ⟦{粕漬|かすづ}け→粕漬け：08230_kasuzuke⟧ (sake-lees pickling) or ⟦{味噌漬|みそづ}け→味噌漬け：24781_misozuke⟧ (miso pickling). {山葵漬|わさびづ}け uses the entire wasabi plant — not just the root commonly served with sushi.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{山葵漬|わさびづ}け is one of the most popular ⟦{土産|みやげ}→土産：03746_miyage⟧ (souvenirs) from {静岡県|しずおかけん}, particularly from the {伊豆|いず} region. It has a sharp, pungent kick similar to fresh wasabi but mellowed by the sweetness of ⟦{酒粕|さけかす}→酒粕：14773_sakekasu⟧ (sake lees).
